verdict.rationale: Netlify's own marketing claims team-scoped management of access, secrets, and environment variables, which matches the story directly. That evidence is a single one-line vendor claim with no supporting detail or independent confirmation, so how deep the capability goes is unproven. Missing for 10: role/permission model details, secret-scoping/encryption documentation, centralized env var UI/API/CLI specifics, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can manage team-level access, secrets, and environment variables centrally

citations.quote: Manage access, secrets, and env vars by team
